lines: What can a few ninja do! We'll crush you all togeー
The soldier's face suddenly froze solid.
A red diagonal line ran from his shoulder to his side, and he collapsed to the floor as his upper body slid off his lower half, blood spraying everywhere.
Heh-heh, guys who ambush never expect to be ambushed themselves.
From behind the soldier who'd been cut clean in two, Kozuki Sana appeared with a katana in her right hand and a can of liquor in her left.
Nearby lay the corpse of a soldier who'd been cut down before he had a chance to scream.
You don't have time to be shocked!
D-Don't panic! It's just two more of them! Get in positionーgwaaghh!!
The soldiers fell into a complete state of panic as their bodies were chopped to bits as if put through a wood chipper.
Hebiko sprinted in with Shikanosuke held in her octopus tentacle.
Small sparks of static electricity crackled in succession.
They struck the exoskeletons's heads where all their important sensors were concentrated.
『The Lightning Taimanin isn't supposed to be here, right!?』
The soldiers inside the exoskeletons became further disoriented as their sensors began to fail them.
Heh-heh, depends on how you use it, you know? Now, Kirara-senpai!!
Kirara quickly raised her leg overhead.
She stamped the ground with her foot charged with the power of ice.
Huge icicles emerged from the ground with clear, piercing sounds like fracturing glass, and froze all of the powered exoskeletons in an instant.
Yes! We'll dismantle each and every one!
The two who boasted the greatest destructive power even among the Taimanin, approached the frozen iron coffins.
Shit! What's going on!? Status report!
C-, communications currently down!! Status completely unknown!!
Don't be ridiculous! Keep calling until you get someone!
Y-Yes sir! This is HQ! This is HQ! Come in!! Come in!!
The captain of the raiding party ground his teeth at the unexpected circumstances.
It should have been an easy mission.
One to trample outdated ninja underfoot with state-of-the-art powered exoskeletons.
That was how it was supposed to go...
He hadn't even realized that the communications officer's loud voice could no longer be heard.
He was slumped over the communication equipment before him as if he had suddenly fallen asleep.
What're you doing!? Did you get an answer!? ...Huh?
It was not just the communication soldier who'd fallen silent,
but all the other soldiers too.
To be precise, every one of his subordinates around him was lying sprawled on the ground, motionless like sandbags.
that an arm had soundlessly grown from out of the soldiers' shadows and cut them down one by one with the ninjato in its grip.
Did they use sleeping gas on them?
Or perhaps it's one of those weird Jutsu that those ninja used?
It was such a cheerful voice that it felt out of place.
Where... where the hell are you!!?
He fired his gun randomly in confusion.
Even when the magazine went empty, his finger wouldn't stop pulling the trigger.
Uh ohhh, out of bullets, huh?
A woman suddenly appeared behind the fear-stricken man.
You shouldn't underestimate the Taimanin, y'know♪
Those were the last words the man heard.
The man's throat had already been cut, his fear still plastered on his face.
